name: glasshouse-report
description: The glasshouse report suite: renders a glasshouse-report JSON into one self-contained HTML. No framework, no bundler; tsc output is checked in.

scripts.check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && npm test && npm run size && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.size: node -e "const s=require('fs').statSync('dist/report.js').size; console.log('dist/report.js', s, 'bytes'); if (s > 200*1024) { console.error('over the 200 KB budget'); process.exit(1) }"
